name: Ram cuon cai
summary: Ram cuốn cải is a fried spring roll wrapped in cabbage, at Con Market’s outdoor counters and on Phạm Hồng Thái and Phan Tứ.
origin: Con Market and the night streets. The cabbage and the fry are what is recorded.
howToEat: Eat the cabbage and the fried roll together.
where: Outdoor counters at Con Market. The 2019 account starts that row after 15:00. Also on Phạm Hồng Thái and Phan Tứ.
seoTitle: Ram cuon cai — fried spring roll in cabbage
